newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian postal workers strike over cuts.
newsitem.headline: Italian postal workers strike over cuts.

text.p: Post offices across Italy were shut on Monday as postal workers staged a one-day strike in protest against 1997 budget spending cuts in their service and work contract issues.
All services and pensions payments were halted for the day.

Union leaders have complained that the state-run Ente Poste, which operates postal services throughout the country, has been harder hit by cuts than other bodies such as the rail company. The dispute also involves a management-imposed freeze on hiring.
The postal strike followed a one-day railway strike on Sunday, the first of several planned rail protests this month against government plans to reorganise the state-owned Ferrovie dello Stato.
